connectors.steam.name: Steam
connectors.steam.choose.title: Choose how to use Steam
connectors.steam.choose.body: With a free Steam key, Ludiary sees your whole library. Without a key, it only shows the games installed on this computer.
connectors.steam.choose.noKey: Steam without a key: installed only
connectors.steam.login.title: Sign in to Steam
connectors.steam.login.body: Sign in with your Steam account. Ludiary only receives your public identifier; it never sees your password.
connectors.steam.login.cancelled: You cancelled the sign-in to Steam. Try again when you want to connect.
connectors.steam.apikey.title: Create your Steam key
connectors.steam.apikey.body:
The key is a free code that lets Ludiary read your library. It takes a few seconds.
Press “Open the page”: Steam opens in a new tab. Sign in if it asks you to.
In “Domain Name” type: localhost
Tick that you accept the terms and press “Register”.
Copy the code shown next to “Key” (32 letters and numbers).
Come back to this tab and press “Paste”.
connectors.steam.profile.title: Make your games public
connectors.steam.profile.body:
For Ludiary to see your games, your Steam profile and game details must be public.
In Steam, open your profile and press “Edit Profile”.
Go to “Privacy Settings”.
Set “My profile” and “Game details” to “Public”.
connectors.steam.error.format: That key does not look right. It must be 32 letters and numbers (A to F and 0 to 9), with no spaces.
connectors.steam.error.key: Steam does not accept that key. Check that you copied it whole, or that it has not been revoked, and try again.
connectors.steam.error.openid: Steam could not confirm your sign-in. Start again.
connectors.steam.error.privateProfile: Your game details are private, so Ludiary cannot see your games. Make “Game details” public in your Steam privacy settings.
connectors.steam.error.sessionExpired: Steam has signed you out. Reconnect the account.
connectors.steam.disconnect.revokeHint: Ludiary deletes the key. To cancel it in Steam, press Revoke at steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey.
connectors.steam.errors.malformedFile: Steam has a file that Ludiary cannot read. That game is skipped.
connectors.steam.errors.invalidAppId: This Steam game has an invalid identifier and cannot be launched.
connectors.steam.errors.launcherMissing: Steam was not found on this computer. Install Steam or check that it is detected in Settings.
connectors.steam.collections.notFound: Ludiary did not find Steam collections on this computer. Open Steam once, or connect your Steam account if you use several.
connectors.steam.collections.ambiguous: There are several Steam accounts on this computer. Connect yours in Settings to bring in its collections.
connectors.steam.collections.accountNotF: Your connected Steam account has no saved collections on this computer.
